PluginData.Author: Viktor
PluginData.Tooltip: Server companion of the Undo client plugin: undo and redo for the players of a dedicated server.
PluginData.Description:
Undo and redo for the players of a dedicated server, as in single player.
Players need the Undo client plugin from PluginHub. The server records what they build, remove, paste, delete, paint and change in the terminal, keeps each player's history in the world save and replays Ctrl-Z / Ctrl-Y here, where removed blocks and deleted grids come back under their old ids with their settings, inventory and links. Clients only ask for steps; every check runs on the server.
Only for players with creative tools enabled, or in a creative world.
The grid history (Ctrl-H) lists each player's backed up grids from the server's grid store, with a budget per player and for all players.
Please see the full documentation on GitHub: https://github.com/viktor-ferenczi/se-undo
For support please join the Pulsar Discord: https://discord.gg/z8ZczP2YZY
